title: Weak convergence implies local flat convergence for integer multiplicity currents (Simon Ch. 6, 7.2)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and T_j, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) integer multiplicity with sup_j (M_W(T_j) + M_W(∂T_j)) < ∞ for every open W with closure(W) compact and contained in U, and T_j ⇀ T in U. Then for every such open W there are integer multiplicity R_j ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(U) and S_j ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with T − T_j − S_j = ∂R_j for every j (Simon writes this as T − T_j = ∂R_j + S_j) and M_W(R_j) + M_W(S_j) → 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + (Ts j).boundary.massOn W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ∃ (R : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (R j) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (S j) ∧ T - Ts j - S j = (R j).boundary) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => (R j).massOn W + (S j).massOn W) atTop (𝓝 0)
